Q3_FY2025_Jan_Mar.notes: February had no project invoices - only retainer GST collected. BAS lodged early.

Q4_FY2025_Apr_Jun.notes: May Lumen Labs campaign ($650 GST) significantly boosted Q4 collections. BAS not yet lodged as at 30 June 2025. Note: Lumen Labs invoice paid in May so GST due in Q4 BAS.

account_balances.notes: Strong start - two retainers plus two project payments. PAYG instalment ($1,800) was biggest single outgoing. Renew Wellness social media invoice outstanding.
QUIET MONTH - retainers only, no new project invoices issued. Renew Wellness Jan invoice paid late. Low expenses kept balance healthy despite low revenue.
BAS payment ($2,876) and PAYG instalment ($1,800) were significant cash hits. Brand voice guide project boosted income. Renew Wellness website copy outstanding.
Renew Wellness finally paid March invoice (late). Content strategy deck paid on time by Harlow Digital. Low expense month - no PAYG or BAS due.
BEST MONTH - Lumen Labs brand campaign ($7,150) paid promptly. Two retainers plus case study project. Renew Wellness EDM invoice outstanding at month end.
PAYG instalment Q4 ($1,800) paid. Accounting fees for BAS + tax planning ($495). Renew Wellness finally paid May EDM invoice. Annual report copy paid by Harlow Digital.

CLIENT-BLOOM.notes: Reliable, prompt payer. Retainer + two ad hoc projects (brand voice guide in March, case studies in May).

CLIENT-HARLOW.notes: Reliable retainer client. Email campaign in Jan, content strategy deck in Apr, annual report in Jun all paid on time.

CLIENT-RENEW.notes: SLOW PAYER — consistently pays 14–22 days after due date. Web copy, social media packs, EDM campaigns. All eventually paid but always late.

CLIENT-LUMEN.notes: New client, May 2025. Melbourne startup - paid large brand campaign invoice ahead of due date. Potential for retainer relationship.
